entities.name: Lord of Tresserhorn
entities.description: An undead replacement for Lim-Dûl, built by Chaeska from the flesh and bone of a dozen Kjeldoran heroes.

entities.name: Chaeska
entities.description: Keeper of Tresserhorn, a necromancer who created the Lord of Tresserhorn.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A necromancer taken to Shandalar by Leshrac at the end of his battle.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Took Lim-Dûl with him to Shandalar.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: A mage who destroyed the Lord of Tresserhorn.

entities.name: Jaya
entities.description: A mage who returned to Tresserhorn with Jodah.

entities.name: Tresserhorn
entities.description: The keep that later fell beneath the Sea of Laments.

entities.name: Sea of Laments
entities.description: The rising sea that swallowed Tresserhorn.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl's Battle
entities.description: Battle of Lim-Dûl against the Kjeldorans and Balduvians.

events.summary: Leshrac takes Lim-Dûl to Shandalar, leaving Chaeska masterless.
events.quote: After Leshrac took Lim-Dûl with him to Shandalar

events.summary: Chaeska creates a new Lord of Tresserhorn to keep Tresserhorn's undead from rebelling.
events.quote: the Lord of Tresserhorn was built from the flesh and bone of a dozen Kjeldoran heroes

events.summary: The Lord of Tresserhorn attacks Jodah and Jaya upon their return.
events.quote: the Lord of Tresserhorn attacked them

events.summary: Jodah destroys the Lord of Tresserhorn.
events.quote: Jodah then destroyed the Lord of Tresserhorn to avoid a large axe blow to the head

events.summary: Chaeska swears to keep the armies at bay if allowed to rebuild the Lord; the mages agree.
Tresserhorn falls beneath the rising Sea of Laments.
events.quote: the keep of Tresserhorn fell beneath the waves of the rising Sea of Laments

relations.note: Chaeska was Lim-Dûl's servant until left masterless.

relations.quote: Jodah then destroyed the Lord of Tresserhorn
